name: cmd_denoise_models_install
description: Install Denoise Model (command `denoise.models.install`). Params: {path, acknowledged: true, activate?: true, background?: false} → {installed, model} or {started} — install a denoise model from a file: an .onnx with a denoise-model.json beside it, or an archive LightCraft knows (the darktable `.dtmodel`). `acknowledged` must be true: the user has been shown the model's licence and accepted it. Unless `activate` is false it becomes the model in use.
